senses.gloss: m.(b. h.;נזל, cmp. Arab.manzil hospitium) [station of the stars,] constellation of the Zodiac; in gen. planet.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 10:6">Gen. R. s. 10</cite> <he>יש מ׳ שגומר הלוכו וכ׳</he> there is a planet that finishes its circuit in thirty days …, in twelve months &c.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 10:6">Ib.</cite> <he>נוגה מהלכת י״ב מזלות … מ׳ וכ׳</he> the Venus passes the twelve constellations in ten months, requiring for each station twenty five days; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="M00781"><he>מַזָּלוֹת</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Berakhot 32b:16">Ber. 32ᵇ</cite> <he>שנים עשר מ׳ וכ׳</he> I have created twelve stations in the heavens, and for each station I have appointed thirty legions (of stars), v. <cite ref="C01169"><he>גַּסְטְרָא</he></cite>. Tosef. ib. VII (VI), 6 <he>הרואה … ואת המ׳</he> [<he>כסדרן</he>] he who sees the sun, the moon and the stars and planets in their original position (at the end of a lunisolar period).
<cite ref="Shabbat 75a:4">Sabb. 75ᵃ</cite> <he>חישוב תקופות ומ׳</he> the calculation of periods and constellations.

Gen. R. s. 25; Y. Pes. I, 27ᵇ top לא שמשו המ׳ וכ׳ the planets did no service during the year of the flood; a. fr.—עובד כוכבום ומ׳ (abbrev. עכו״ם) idolater, v. עָבַד, a. עֲבוֹדָה.—Trnsf. (astrology) constellation at one’s birth, planet, destiny; guardian angel, angel of destiny.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 10:4">Gen. R. s. 10</cite> <he>אין לך כל עשב … שאין לו מ׳ וכ׳</he> there is not an herb which has not a planet in heaven that strikes it and says, Grow!—
<cite ref="Shabbat 156a:11">Sabb. 156ᵃ</cite> <he>לא מַזַּל יום גורם מ׳ שעה וכ׳</he> not the day’s planet, but the constellation of the hour (of birth) has influence.
<cite ref="Shabbat 156a:12">Ib.</cite> <he>מ׳ מחכים וכ׳</he> the planet (of birth) makes wise, rich &c.
<cite ref="Shabbat 156a:13">Ib.</cite> <he>אין מ׳ לישראל</he> Israel is not dependent on nativity; a. v. fr.
